remarks: Where Lifestyle is Everything. Discover year-round serenity in this exquisite townhome residence near Bruce Park, designed to live like a single-family home. Spanning approximately 5400 sq. ft., the open floor plan is perfect for entertaining, highlighted by French oak hardwood floors and a gourmet Porcelanosa kitchen with custom cabinetry and a coffered ceiling. Upstairs, three spacious bedrooms each feature ensuite Porcelanosa baths, while a private rooftop deck offers stunning water views. The lower-level media room can serve as a fourth bedroom, providing versatility for modern living. Smart-home technology, whole-house audio, and a two-car garage enhance everyday convenience. Just moments from the train, shops, and the park, this home offers luxury, comfort, and location all in one
